objective: Calibrate directional confidence intervals for genuine negative zero and positive trends without changing SG050's HAC estimator or three-way label semantics.
data: Nine SG050 synthetic scenario families, each direction {-1,0,+1}; 240 continuation observations; HAC3 ten-observation median blocks.

calibration.quantile: .90 empirical split quantile of abs(estimated_slope - programmed_slope)/HAC_SE; ceil((n+1)*.90)=487

decision: Positive if lower CI>0; negative if upper CI<0; zero if entire CI within [-.0032,+.0032]; unresolved otherwise. No hidden scenario or true slope provided during decision.

pilot.disclosure: Pilot inspected before freeze; no further parameter tuning.

limitations: Calibration and holdout share generator families; exchangeability and within-regime coverage not established.
This is a fixed240 interval audit, not an adaptive stopping policy.
Higher interval width may reduce wrong directional claims but withhold true directions.
All metrics synthetic; no real-world field validation.
